crossRefs.note: He who pampers his servant from youth will have him become a son in the end.

translations.web: He who pampers his servant from youth will have him become a son in the end.
translations.bsb: A servant pampered from his youth will bring grief in the end.
translations.kjv: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child shall have him become his son at the length.
translations.asv: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child Shall have him become a son at the last.
